about: Who may do what. A SKILL is a written area of responsibility (skills/<name>/SKILL.md): what it is in charge of, its rules, and the tools it may use. A TOOL is one specific action (tools/<name>/tool.json) that code runs when a model asks for it; all tools are read-only. A JOB is one internal call to a model with a fixed prompt and output schema (jobs/<name>/), usually what answers a tool. An agent is given the skills listed here, and only the tools those skills name for its channel. tests/docs.test.ts checks this file against the folders and against what each model is actually given.

chat.note: The chat agent's writing brief is still one file, jobs/ask/prompt.md; it is split into these skills after the retrieval test set exists, so the split can be measured.

jobs.name: plan-queries
jobs.does: Writes the search queries for the first search of a chat answer.

jobs.name: ask
jobs.does: Writes the checked chat answer: steps with a page and a quote each, suggested checks, a hazard flag, figures.

jobs.name: rerank
jobs.does: Orders the sections a search found and drops the ones that do not answer.

jobs.name: look
jobs.does: Looks at one camera picture: finds a named part, what a finger points at, or says what is visible.

jobs.name: identify
jobs.does: Sample fault trees: classifies a fault from a picture or a description.

jobs.name: interpret
jobs.does: Sample fault trees: reads a free-text reply as yes, no or unclear.
